checks.name: ck_audit_log__actor_role
checks.definition: ([actor_role] IS NULL OR ([actor_role]='HORSE_OWNER' OR [actor_role]='GROOM' OR [actor_role]='VETERINARIAN' OR [actor_role]='WORK_RIDER' OR [actor_role]='TRAINER' OR [actor_role]='HEAD_TRAINER' OR [actor_role]='CLUB_MANAGER'))

checks.name: ck_audit_log__target_pair
checks.definition: ([target_type] IS NULL AND [target_id] IS NULL OR [target_type] IS NOT NULL AND [target_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_care_plan_item__responsible_role
checks.definition: ([responsible_role] IS NULL OR ([responsible_role]='HORSE_OWNER' OR [responsible_role]='GROOM' OR [responsible_role]='VETERINARIAN' OR [responsible_role]='WORK_RIDER' OR [responsible_role]='TRAINER' OR [responsible_role]='HEAD_TRAINER' OR [responsible_role]='CLUB_MANAGER'))

checks.name: ck_care_task__completion_pair
checks.definition: ([completed_at] IS NULL AND [completed_by_user_id] IS NULL OR [completed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [completed_by_user_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_care_task__source_xor
checks.definition: (((case when [care_plan_item_id] IS NOT NULL then (1) else (0) end+case when [nutrition_plan_item_id] IS NOT NULL then (1) else (0) end)+case when [treatment_plan_id] IS NOT NULL then (1) else (0) end)=(1))

checks.name: ck_horse__dam_ref_xor_name
checks.definition: (NOT ([dam_horse_id] IS NOT NULL AND [dam_name] IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: ck_horse__health_status
checks.definition: ([health_status] IS NULL OR ([health_status]='QUARANTINED' OR [health_status]='INJURED' OR [health_status]='MONITORING' OR [health_status]='FIT'))

checks.name: ck_horse__sire_not_dam
checks.definition: ([sire_horse_id] IS NULL OR [dam_horse_id] IS NULL OR [sire_horse_id]<>[dam_horse_id])

checks.name: ck_horse__sire_ref_xor_name
checks.definition: (NOT ([sire_horse_id] IS NOT NULL AND [sire_name] IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: ck_horse_strength__code
checks.definition: ([strength_code]='BALANCE' OR [strength_code]='STRENGTH' OR [strength_code]='ENDURANCE' OR [strength_code]='SPEED' OR [strength_code]='CLOSER' OR [strength_code]='STALKER' OR [strength_code]='FRONT_RUNNER' OR [strength_code]='SYNTHETIC' OR [strength_code]='DIRT' OR [strength_code]='TURF' OR [strength_code]='STAYING' OR [strength_code]='MIDDLE_DISTANCE' OR [strength_code]='MILE' OR [strength_code]='SPRINT')

checks.name: ck_incident__single_source_context
checks.definition: (((case when [pre_session_check_id] IS NOT NULL then (1) else (0) end+case when [training_session_id] IS NOT NULL then (1) else (0) end)+case when [care_task_id] IS NOT NULL then (1) else (0) end)<=(1))

checks.name: ck_medical_case__closed_state
checks.definition: ([status]='OPEN' AND [closed_at] IS NULL OR [status]='CLOSED' AND [closed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [closed_at]>=[opened_at])

checks.name: ck_monitoring_alert__ack_pair
checks.definition: ([acknowledged_at] IS NULL AND [acknowledged_by_user_id] IS NULL OR [acknowledged_at] IS NOT NULL AND [acknowledged_by_user_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_monitoring_alert__action_after_ack
checks.definition: ([action_taken] IS NULL OR [acknowledged_at] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_monitoring_alert__action_taken
checks.definition: ([action_taken] IS NULL OR ([action_taken]='STOP' OR [action_taken]='PAUSE' OR [action_taken]='REDUCE_INTENSITY' OR [action_taken]='ACKNOWLEDGE'))

checks.name: ck_notification__target_pair
checks.definition: ([target_type] IS NULL AND [target_id] IS NULL OR [target_type] IS NOT NULL AND [target_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_preventive_task__completion_pair
checks.definition: ([completed_at] IS NULL AND [completed_by_user_id] IS NULL OR [completed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [completed_by_user_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_program_adjustment_request__request_type
checks.definition: ([request_type]='OTHER_STRUCTURAL' OR [request_type]='TOTAL_DURATION' OR [request_type]='PHASE_TIMELINE' OR [request_type]='PHASE_WORKLOAD_INTENSITY' OR [request_type]='PHASE_OBJECTIVE' OR [request_type]='PHASE_STRUCTURE' OR [request_type]='TARGET_RACE' OR [request_type]='PRIMARY_GOAL' OR [request_type]='SOURCE_TEMPLATE')

checks.name: ck_program_adjustment_request__review_state
checks.definition: ([status]='PENDING' AND [reviewed_at] IS NULL AND [reviewed_by_user_id] IS NULL OR ([status]='REJECTED' OR [status]='APPROVED') AND [reviewed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [reviewed_by_user_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_race_registration__withdrawn_state
checks.definition: ([status]='WITHDRAWN' AND [withdrawn_at] IS NOT NULL OR [status]<>'WITHDRAWN' AND [withdrawn_at] IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_race_result__prize_currency_code
checks.definition: ([prize_currency_code] IS NULL OR ([prize_currency_code]) collate Latin1_General_BIN like '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]')

checks.name: ck_race_result__prize_pair
checks.definition: ([prize_amount] IS NULL AND [prize_currency_code] IS NULL OR [prize_amount] IS NOT NULL AND [prize_currency_code] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_registration_request__hash_only_while_pending
checks.definition: ([status]='PENDING_APPROVAL' AND [password_hash] IS NOT NULL OR [status]<>'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND [password_hash] IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_registration_request__review_state
checks.definition: ([status]='PENDING_APPROVAL' AND [reviewed_at] IS NULL AND [reviewed_by_user_id] IS NULL AND [approved_role_id] IS NULL AND [created_user_id] IS NULL AND [decision_reason] IS NULL OR [status]='APPROVED' AND [reviewed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [reviewed_by_user_id] IS NOT NULL AND [approved_role_id] IS NOT NULL AND [created_user_id] IS NOT NULL OR [status]='REJECTED' AND [reviewed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [reviewed_by_user_id] IS NOT NULL AND [approved_role_id] IS NULL AND [created_user_id] IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_restriction_exercise_rule__target
checks.definition: ([exercise_definition_id] IS NOT NULL OR [exercise_type_note] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_role__role_code
checks.definition: ([role_code]='HORSE_OWNER' OR [role_code]='GROOM' OR [role_code]='VETERINARIAN' OR [role_code]='WORK_RIDER' OR [role_code]='TRAINER' OR [role_code]='HEAD_TRAINER' OR [role_code]='CLUB_MANAGER')

checks.name: ck_session_exercise__no_ack_for_category_a
checks.definition: ([suitability_category] IS NULL OR [suitability_category]<>'A' OR [acknowledgement_note] IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_session_exercise__non_negative
checks.definition: (([distance] IS NULL OR [distance]>=(0)) AND ([duration] IS NULL OR [duration]>=(0)) AND ([repetitions] IS NULL OR [repetitions]>=(0)) AND ([rest_interval] IS NULL OR [rest_interval]>=(0)))

checks.name: ck_session_exercise__suitability_category
checks.definition: ([suitability_category] IS NULL OR ([suitability_category]='D' OR [suitability_category]='C' OR [suitability_category]='B' OR [suitability_category]='A'))

checks.name: ck_template_strength_focus__code
checks.definition: ([strength_code]='BALANCE' OR [strength_code]='STRENGTH' OR [strength_code]='ENDURANCE' OR [strength_code]='SPEED' OR [strength_code]='CLOSER' OR [strength_code]='STALKER' OR [strength_code]='FRONT_RUNNER' OR [strength_code]='SYNTHETIC' OR [strength_code]='DIRT' OR [strength_code]='TURF' OR [strength_code]='STAYING' OR [strength_code]='MIDDLE_DISTANCE' OR [strength_code]='MILE' OR [strength_code]='SPRINT')

checks.name: ck_training_metric_sample__has_value
checks.definition: ([heart_rate] IS NOT NULL OR [speed] IS NOT NULL OR [distance] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_training_metric_sample__non_negative
checks.definition: (([heart_rate] IS NULL OR [heart_rate]>=(0)) AND ([speed] IS NULL OR [speed]>=(0)) AND ([distance] IS NULL OR [distance]>=(0)))

checks.name: ck_training_session__actual_period
checks.definition: ([actual_end] IS NULL OR [actual_start] IS NOT NULL AND [actual_end]>=[actual_start])

checks.name: ck_veterinary_examination__case_unless_baseline
checks.definition: ([exam_type]='BASELINE' AND [medical_case_id] IS NULL OR [exam_type]<>'BASELINE' AND [medical_case_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_veterinary_examination__health_status_set
checks.definition: ([health_status_set] IS NULL OR ([health_status_set]='QUARANTINED' OR [health_status_set]='INJURED' OR [health_status_set]='MONITORING' OR [health_status_set]='FIT'))

checks.name: ck_veterinary_examination__recovery_outcome
checks.definition: ([recovery_outcome] IS NULL OR [exam_type]='RE_EXAMINATION' AND ([recovery_outcome]='RECOVERED' OR [recovery_outcome]='IMPROVING' OR [recovery_outcome]='NOT_RECOVERED'))
